official_observations.note: Complete official root/recursive child faces; identity and text only, not CN timing calibration.

internal_policy: Brood Keeper checks actual owner hand after leaving it, current/all Dragon membership, and uses exact Nightmare Slicer with ordinary EquipWeapon.

Release captures original hand minion physical references and original Legendary subset together, then gives all +1/+1 and those original Legendary references an extra +2/+1. New entries or reentries do not gain old rewards.
Spirits/Grace use existing native ChooseOneSpec, root payment and captured branch. Four complete source option records are choice-only zero-cost descriptors, not new playable spells.

Spirits summons three exact EX1_tk11 then, in required combined body, two EDR_233t2. Grace combined body deals four SPELL damage to enemy hero then summons two existing EDR_850pe. Exact combined order is local pending CN calibration, not a new combination mechanism.
Named summons use SummonByCard with actual source/cast cause; complete Beast/Undead dual tribes retained.
EDR_525 and its two choice children are evidence only; no weapon root approximated as minion, no private choice/engine logic added.
